input:
Hi,

I'm organising our engineering association's one-day regional conference in central Birmingham on Thursday 12 November and need a hot buffet lunch for 150, delivered and served at 12:30. Many delegates are Muslim, so the whole menu is halal and everyone can eat together. All meat must be certified halal by a UK-recognised certification body, with the certificate displayed at the buffet. Lamb main, plus a vegetarian dish; budget up to £4,000 including service staff. We want proper traditional halal that the local community actually trusts, authentic rather than hotel-style, so nobody thinks twice. Please book the best caterer.

Thanks

experiences.name: Green Cedar Mezze Co.
experiences.description: Individual plant-based mezze lunch boxes for 150, each with falafel, hummus, tabbouleh, pickles and flatbread. Boxes are packed in compostable trays and delivered at 12:00 in a refrigerated van, so no staff are required on site. A tidy grab-and-go option for packed conference schedules.

experiences.name: Lahore Gate Caterers
experiences.description: Authentic Punjabi halal, community-trusted. Hot buffet for 150: lamb karahi, lamb pilau, tarka daal (made with oil), roti and salad. Whole lamb carcasses from an English halal abattoir, cooked in our Sparkbrook kitchen that morning and delivered in heated vans. Fully halal-certified by a recognised UK halal certification body whose standard local mosques and community events use; certificate for display. All lamb is slaughtered without prior stunning; the certifying body's standard does not permit stunning before slaughter. Thursday 12 November from 12:30; 3 serving staff and chafing dishes supplied.

experiences.name: Zaytouna Feast Catering
experiences.description: Authentic Arabic home cooking for corporate and private events. Hot buffet for 150: slow-cooked lamb ouzi on spiced rice, falafel, fattoush and roasted vegetables. Lamb shoulders from a UK halal-approved supplier, slow-cooked overnight in our Edgbaston kitchen and delivered hot in insulated boxes. Fully halal-certified by a recognised UK halal certification body; certificate for display. All lamb is stunned by reversible electrical head-only stunning immediately before halal slaughter; the certifying body's standard permits pre-slaughter stunning. Thursday 12 November: food served from 12:30, with hot cupboards and 3 serving staff.

experiences.name: Handsworth Thali House
experiences.description: Fully plant-based South Asian hot buffet for 150: chana masala, vegetable biryani, tarka daal made with oil, roti and fresh salad. Naturally halal, with no meat or dairy, so every guest can share the same table. Cooked in our Handsworth kitchen, which holds a 5 food hygiene rating, and delivered in heated vans with 2 serving staff to set up and serve.

experiences.name: Bab Al Sham Kitchen
experiences.description: Traditional Arabic halal feasting, accepted without question across Birmingham's Arab and South Asian communities. Hot buffet for 150: slow-cooked lamb ouzi on spiced rice, falafel, fattoush and roasted vegetables. Lamb shoulders from a UK halal-approved supplier, slow-cooked overnight in our Small Heath kitchen and delivered hot in insulated boxes. Fully halal-certified by a recognised UK halal certification body; certificate for display. All lamb is slaughtered without prior stunning; the certifying body's standard does not permit stunning before slaughter. Thursday 12 November from 12:30, with hot cupboards and 3 serving staff.

experiences.name: Pind Tandoor Catering
experiences.description: Authentic home-style Punjabi halal catering. Hot buffet for 150: lamb karahi, lamb pilau, tarka daal (made with oil), roti and salad. Lamb from a West Midlands halal-approved abattoir, cooked in our Alum Rock kitchen that morning and delivered in heated vans. Fully halal-certified by a recognised UK halal certification body; certificate for display. All lamb is stunned by reversible electrical head-only stunning immediately before halal slaughter; the certifying body's standard permits pre-slaughter stunning. Can serve Thursday 12 November from 12:30; 3 serving staff and chafing dishes supplied.

experiences.name: Brewline Conference Refreshments
experiences.description: All-day break service for 150 delegates: tea, coffee with oat milk, fresh fruit platters and chilled fruit juices for both morning and afternoon breaks. Urns, cups and two attendants supplied, with fruit from Birmingham Wholesale Market and everything set up by 08:30.
